made_for: issue 1752 Gate 3 (Ryan, Nov 24 2026: 'More music, more variety, whatever we got with the sound credits')
note: Wave F: every sound still on an old placeholder, the Gate 3 re-rolls, and 2 more takes of the 27 most-heard keepers for the round robin. Wave M: a full soundtrack (calm and intense battle layers per faction, title, map, boss, reward, stings) plus one stem split test. Prompts follow the Gate 2 doctrine (plan sections 2 to 8). UI stays acoustic and mechanical (Ryan dislikes electronic UI cues).
